story.titleZh: 阿尔派车队Q1晋级Q2：加斯利P6，科拉平托P12
story.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队在排位赛Q1中晋级Q2，加斯利排名P6，科拉平托放弃最后一个计时圈，排名P12。
story.originalTitle: And we’re through to Q2 👍🙌 Pierre - P6 Franco aborts his final timed lap - P12.
story.summaryEn:
And we’re through to Q2 👍🙌
Pierre - P6
Franco aborts his final timed lap - P12.BWT Alpine Formula One Team: Q1 - 16/18 MINS
Strong laps from both boys 💪 
As it stands P8 for Franco and P9 for Pierre - split by a small margin.
detailZh:
我们晋级Q2了👍🙌
皮埃尔 - P6
弗兰科放弃了他的最后一个计时圈 - P12。BWT 阿尔派 F1车队：Q1 - 16/18分钟
两位车手都做出了强劲的圈速💪
目前弗兰科P8，皮埃尔P9——差距很小。
